title: ID0391928-DC/Si-D/TR-[MP / RD 170003113] Router shares the IPs outside and causes outgoing traffic
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
Customer uses a LAN connection for internet. Router 1 is sharing the IPs to the WAN port of the customer's factory so it affects the other devices who connects the Internet. We have to connect the Teltonika UI remotely and change the configurations that causes the outgoing traffic.
PS: They operate the charger offline most of the day due to this issue so we have to request them to make charger online before the access.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0391928-DC/Si-D/TR-[MP / RD 170003113] Router shares the IPs outside and causes outgoing traffic CRM:00643001108
additional_info.body:
Hi Shrey,
To clarify:
The XF3 (Siemens Router) should use the M2M SIM card provided by the factory.
No, they don’t do that because they have to use a local sim-card to follow the official procedures. But this customer is using the LAN connection to get the charger online and it works.
For the XF4 (Backend Router), if the backend uses a LAN connection, the customer’s Ethernet cable should be connected to the WAN port of the router, while the LAN port of the router should be connected to the Ethernet switch of our charger.
No, they don’t have a problem with XF4, because they don’t use that with the reason of not having a backend. They only use the XF3 and it connects to internet via LAN.
The charger is working fine. Issue is with more like router configurations which causes the outgoing traffic to other IoT devices in the factory. I created a ticket so NOC or L3 team can get an SSH access and we can check the Teltonika UI remotely, without a need to visit the site for this.
